description: Certificate of Lawful Development (Proposed): Single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single storey side to rear extension (Demolition of attached garage)
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal is NOT therefore a lawful development.</p>

<p>The proposed development extends beyond a wall forming a side elevation of the original dwellinghouse for a width greater than half the width of the original dwellinghouse. Therefore, the proposed is not within the tolerances of paragraph A.1(j)(iii) of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">The proposal development by reason of its depth by more than 3 metres would not be in the tolerences of&nbsp;paragraph A.1(f)(i) of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span></span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif"><span style="line-height:150%">The proposed development would be&nbsp;within 2 metres of the boundary of the curtilage of the dwellinghouse with a height to the eaves exceeding 3 metres. Therefore, the proposed is not within the tolerances of paragraph A.1(i) of Schedule 2, Part 1 Class A of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.</span></span></span></p>
